purpose: Independent verification of fund tracing (amount reconciliation, branch endings, cycles, depth/node limits) against direct SQL on the served synthetic ledger. Synthetic data only; no accuracy claims.
ground_truth_use: data/v3_forensic/demo/{roles,scenarios,accounts,transactions}.csv read by this verifier only, to select accounts and identify the planted loop transfers; never passed to the engine.

engine_rules_verified_against.received_traced_amount: Investigated account: always 0. Every other account: sum of traced transfers INTO it whose direction is 'downstream' and that are not loop-closing (is_cycle) transfers.
engine_rules_verified_against.sent_traced_amount: Sum of ALL traced transfers OUT of the account, whatever their direction, loop-closing ones included.
engine_rules_verified_against.forwarded_at_least/forwarded_at_most: Copied from investigation.exposure.per_account (downstream accounts only, first 60): over [first traced downstream non-loop receipt, +onward_window_hours], ordered by (timestamp, transaction_id): traced += receipt; traced = min(traced, balance_after); forwarded_min = received - traced, forwarded_max = min(received, outgoing in window). 'received' counts only traced receipts inside that window.
engine_rules_verified_against.observed_downstream_total: Sum of distinct traced downstream transfers (each transfer once).
engine_rules_verified_against.traced_outgoing_total: Sum of the downstream seed transfers selected for tracing.
engine_rules_verified_against.is_cycle: Far party already on the edge's own path back to the root, or first reached from the opposite side of the root with timing that lets money run round: upstream edge: follows(intro(far), edge) or follows(own_seed, other_seed); downstream edge: follows(edge, intro(far)) or follows(other_seed, own_seed); follows(r, p) = r.ts <= p.ts <= r.ts + window.
engine_rules_verified_against.in_cycle: Account on a closed loop of at least 3 distinct accounts formed by traced transfers.
engine_rules_verified_against.endings_order: cycle, cash withdrawal (downstream ATM_CASH_OUT), convergence (opposite side -> joins_opposite, same side -> already_examined), hop >= max_depth, node limit, per-account cap, nothing in window.

a1_trace_edges_match_ledger.description: Every investigation.trace.edges transfer exists in the ledger with identical timestamp, sender, receiver, amount, channel and balances.

a2_branch_steps_match_ledger.description: Every fund_trace.branches step exists in the ledger; its amount equals the ledger amount, its accounts list follows the ledger's sender/receiver.

a3_every_transaction_dict_matches_ledger.description: Every object anywhere in the response that names a transaction_id and an amount matches the ledger (amount, timestamp, sender, receiver).

a4_trace_edges_unique.description: No transfer appears twice in investigation.trace.edges.

a5_received_traced_rule.description: graph_relationship.received_traced_amount equals the engine's stated rule recomputed from the ledger amounts of the traced transfers.

a6_sent_traced_rule.description: graph_relationship.sent_traced_amount equals the engine's stated rule recomputed from ledger amounts.

a8_exposure_recomputed_from_ledger.description: exposure.per_account traced_in/outgoing/forwarded_min/forwarded_max/lowest balance equal an independent SQL recomputation of the documented balance rule.

a9_exposure_received_equals_graph_receiv.description: exposure traced_in_amount (all traced receipts, per-window rule) equals graph_relationship.received_traced_amount, so the forwarded range describes all traced money the account received.

a10_totals_equal_edge_sums.description: observed_downstream_total = sum of distinct downstream edges; traced_outgoing_total = sum of downstream seeds; flagged_outgoing_total <= traced_outgoing_total when flagged; fund_trace.transactions = distinct edges = union of branch transfers; fund_trace.accounts = nodes; cycles_detected = loop-closing edges.

a11_seeds_are_traced.description: Every downstream/upstream seed transfer (counted in traced_outgoing_total) is in the trace.

a12_graph_relationship_counts.description: onward_destinations, traced_paths_in and hop in graph_relationship follow their stated rules over the traced transfers.

a13_other_sender_transfer_matches_ledger.description: For accounts added as other senders, sent_traced_amount equals their flagged transfer in the ledger, received_traced_amount is 0, and that transfer pays an account in the trace.

b1_ending_condition_holds.description: Each ending reason's condition holds against the ledger (see per-reason rules in the report).

b2_max_depth_only_at_max_depth.description: maximum_depth_reached only on a branch whose last hop == max_depth.

b3_max_depth_has_onward_transfers.description: maximum_depth_reached only where the last account actually has a further qualifying transfer in the window (owner rule).

b4_no_forbidden_claims.description: No ending (reason or detail) claims money was recovered, frozen or lost.

b5_every_leaf_has_one_branch.description: Every traced transfer with no traced continuation ends exactly one branch; every loop-closing transfer ends a branch with cycle_detected or a cross-side join.

b6_depth_note_counts_accounts_with_onwar.description: The 'depth limit reached; K account(s) not followed further' note counts only accounts that have a further transfer in the window.

b7_per_account_cap_shown_on_branches.description: An account whose transfers were cut to the 10 largest (truncation note) has at least one branch through it ending 'per_account_limit_applied', and it really had more than 10 qualifying transfers.

c1_cycle_edges_consistent_with_ledger.description: Every is_cycle transfer closes a loop under the documented rule, recomputed from ledger timestamps (own-path or opposite-side timing).

c2_no_missed_same_path_cycle.description: No non-cycle transfer reaches an account already on its own branch path.

c3_in_cycle_accounts_on_real_loop.description: Every in_cycle account lies on a directed loop of >= 3 distinct accounts formed by traced transfers.

c4_circular_loops_detected.description: Every SC-CIRCULAR loop that lies within max_depth of the investigated account (given the engine's own seeds) is closed by an is_cycle transfer and all its members carry in_cycle.

d1_hop_within_max_depth.description: No edge or node hop exceeds max_depth; fund_trace.max_depth_reached <= max_depth.

d3_depth_monotonic.description: Raising max_depth (same max_nodes) never removes or alters an earlier traced transfer.

d4_deterministic.description: Identical requests give the same investigation_digest and identical fund_trace.

d5_branches_are_valid_chains.description: Each branch is a separate time-ordered chain of ledger transfers (parent links, 72 h window, connected accounts), amounts are per transfer (never merged), no two branches are identical, and branches cover exactly the traced transfers.
